summary:
I built a 637-item register for the Al-Zour LNG Import plant and checked the model against the drawings and the ortho (plan, iso and area views). Positions line up with the ortho to within about 5 m everywhere except the diagonal pipe track in the building area (see open questions).

**Sources.** I used five plot plans:
- Process & Utility (T0007, 1:1000)
- LNG Tanks (T0006, 1:1000)
- Jetty (T0005, 1:1500)
- Building (T0008, 1:1000)
- Overall (T0003, 1:3000), used for layout, the sea water intake lines and the environment.

All other PDF pages are comment sheets with no geometry.

**Site frame (EPSG:32639).** The frame actually used is plant north 18.2211° clockwise from grid north, with plant (0,0) at UTM 244336.554 / 3179542.087. The app fitted it from where the overall plan was already placed on the map; I then placed each area plan from its battery-limit coordinates (residual 0.04 m over 10 points). This is not the frame printed in General Note 2 (17.9991°, origin 244338.089 / 3179515.690), which is about 26 m away.

**Heights.** Model base (datum) EL 92.5 = chart datum (ACD) 0. Finished grade is EL 100.000 and the pads are EL 97.5. The cloud check found plant EL = cloud z + 121.70 m.

**What the register holds.**
- **Tanks and process:** 8 full-containment LNG tanks with roof pumps, platforms, jib cranes and elevators. The process area has 12 open rack and 3 submerged combustion vaporizers, the BOG compressors and their shelter, the recondenser and HP pump rows, metering, and the sea water intake and filtration.
- **Utilities and buildings:** substations, generators, utility packages, impounding basins and foam systems, plus admin buildings and parking lots.
- **Jetties:** two jetty heads with loading arms, breasting and mooring dolphins, catwalks and trestles, the offshore flare, and the four subsea intake lines.
- **Environment:** sea, land, the outfall breakwater, paved plots and the main road grid.

**Changes I made in review.**
- Three items in the north-west shore band traced as pipe racks were really the shore rock revetment; I replaced them with one revetment item.
- The flare 60-A-0001 had picked up a 1 m height from the wrong spot in the cloud. I set its top to EL 154.4, read from the flare's cloud cluster about 13 m away, and its base to an assumed deck level.
- Seven loading arms had heights polluted by LNG carriers moored in the scan. I reset them to an assumed deck level of about EL 108 plus 18 m.
- I added two cloud-sourced pipe expansion-loop bands in the tank corridor. These have no tags and low confidence.

**Left as they are.**
- 5 items fell back to the plain extruded type because their settings didn't fit their builder: 50-A-0007-L-01A, 20-A-0052, 20-A-0062, 20-A-0009-G-01 and shelter-building-01.
- 24 items carry drawing heights that disagree with the cloud. I left them flagged for you rather than change them.
open_questions: Site frame: General Note 2 puts plant (0,0) at UTM 244338.089/3179515.690 with plant north 17.9991 deg. The frame used (18.2211 deg, origin 244336.554/3179542.087) was fitted from where the overall plan was already placed on the map, and is about 26 m and 0.22 deg away from the note. Against that frame, the cloud fits most items about +4 m east and -4 m north of their drawn positions (8 of 8 LNG tanks), and the ortho suggests up to about 10 m. Which georeference is authoritative?
246 items are flagged plan_offset. Most look like the systematic frame offset above, not tracing errors; positions were kept as drawn.

Building area: the long diagonal pipe track/pipe rack (pipe-rack-building-01), as traced from T0008, sits about 20 m north of (in the sea beside) the built conveyor/pipe track visible in the ortho. Is the drawn route the as-built route, or is it the ZOR sulphur pier corridor?

The cloud check filled heights for several items from the wrong spots because of plan offsets and the LNG carriers moored at both berths: overbridges A-D (tops about EL 160, which is the tank dome), dolphins BD2/II-BD2, trestle-jetty-1 (top 138), package-tank-pc03/pc04. Also 80-B-01 fire station, shelter-building-01 and other-building-01 came out with tops below EL 99, probably a scan gap. These heights need checking.
The 20-P-0005..0008 LP pumps on the south-row tank roofs have indicative heights (EL 145-150). The cloud puts the north-row roof pumps at about EL 164-166, so the south ones are probably too low.

Height mismatches against drawing-stated elevations: the 40-K-0001A~D BOG compressors (drawing top 109.4 vs cloud about 101.8; the 109.4 may be the shelter crane rail rather than the machine), 40-BC-01, the 30-V-0002 vent drums and pipe racks taking TOS EL 116.2 from Section C-C. Do the section elevations apply to these items as traced?

5 items fell back to the plain extruded type because their settings did not fit their builder: 50-A-0007-L-01A, 20-A-0052, 20-A-0062, 20-A-0009-G-01, shelter-building-01. Their dimensions should be checked.

Environment west of the ortho is low confidence: Unit 98/mainland land, the small-boat harbour and the western spit were traced from the overall plan, whose own grid placement disagrees with my reading of its UTM grid by about 9 m.
The jetty deck elevations are not stated on the jetty plot plan; deck levels of about EL 104.5-108.3 are indicative or come from the cloud.
The sea water intake pipelines and heads from the overall plan have no tags and indicative below-sea elevations.

Unregistered cloud clusters left unnamed: site ground/paving (cand-001/002), tank dome remnants caused by the offset and photo parallax (cand-004, 012-015, 022/023), and moored ships (cand-016 at Jetty II, cand-019 at Jetty I).

P3: 50-A-0001 has no legible label inside this region. The south equipment block in 50-MS-01 is saved untagged; it is probably 50-A-0001. Which shelter row is 50-A-0006 and which is 50-A-0001 is inferred from where the labels sit.
P3: 50-AC-003 (AQMS cabinet for the NG trim heaters) has no legible label. A small box at E1159.5 N599.8 is saved untagged as the likely candidate.
P3: 50-AH-0001 and 50-B-13 were assigned by following the leaders. The 'operator house' 50-B-13 is only about 2.3x2.1 m, so the two may be swapped.

P3: The 30-HEF-002, 30-HEG-002, 30-TC-04 and 30-P-0003 labels sit east of the E1203 match line, and their leaders do not reach any object. Matching them to the box at E1188.6 N571.7 and to the basin group at E1167 N550 is an inference. 30-HEF-002 is labelled twice; the second label (N~588) has no target.
P3: 50-E-0001I (N~514-524) and the BOG compressors 40-K-0001A/B (labels near N533, units south of N520) lie south of this package's region and were not traced.

P3: The ortho is offset from the drawing by about (+5 E, -11 N), and the laydown area / heater piping does not match as built. Drawing positions were kept. The northern bands (N666-692) were read as revetment slope hatching rather than pipe sleepers.
P3: It is assumed, not stated, that Section C-C (TOS 106.0/108.5/112.5/116.2) is the process main pipe rack in this region.
P4: Letter order inside the grouped labels (40-E-0001A~D/E~H, 30-P-0001H~N, 30-V-0002H~N, 30-P-0001A~G, 30-V-0002A~G) is not shown on the plot plan; west->east was assumed.
P4: 40-K-0001C/D: the rotated labels' leaders were followed to the two western units (D westmost); please confirm against the equipment layout.
P4: 40-V-0001/0002/0003 have no clear leaders: assigned by service (vertical drum on octagonal plinth = BOG suction drum, horizontal = drain vessel, small vertical = fuel gas KO drum).
P4: 40-M-0001 desuperheater and 40-H-0001 electric heater could not be pinpointed; placed at the nearest plausible items (low confidence).
P4: Section C-C location is not marked on the plan; its tier levels were applied to both the N-S main rack (9 m width matches) and the process main E-W rack (plan width ~7 m).

P4: Three X-marked boxes with stair hatching (E 1100-1110/N 412-425, E 1145-1154/N 425-433 and N 404-412), and a vertical label that may read '30-STR-001', were not modelled; their purpose is unclear.
P4: Recondenser 30-V-0001 crown elevation is not stated; ~EL 125.5 assumed above PF 124.000.
P4: Ortho imagery appears offset about +6 m E / -11 m N relative to the drawing grid; drawing positions were kept.

P1: The ortho photo doesn't match the drawing south of the screens. The ortho shows the 5 white-roofed drum-screen houses at about N578-588 (drawing: N593-604) and the 14 seawater pumps with green discharge pipes at about N540-554 (drawing: N562.5). The bar-screen channels (N602-615) and the north road/seawall do line up. Is the as-built layout different from this drawing revision?

P1: The 3 north pipe-rack bands (N669-691) fall over open water in the ortho, where a diagonal covered trestle shows instead. Are they jetty or trestle racks rather than rack on grade? What are their tier elevations?
P1: Which pump is 70-P-0005A? Three large rotated labels '70-P-0005?' in the forebay have suffixes I can't read. The motor pump at E899.5 N562.0 is saved with tag null.
P1: 70-P-0005B~D-V-01: I assigned these to the 3 framed drums on the pad at E873.8-880.3, N571.9. The label's leader could also point to the tank compartments inside the diesel pump enclosures.
